/** Keeps comparison table column count in sync with drilled waterfall mocks. */
export function buildPerformanceAndBreakdownDeepDiveDrillComparisonLines(
  columnCount: number,
): ComparisonLineData[] {
  const entityCount = columnCount - 4;
  const entityCells = Array.from({ length: entityCount }, (_, index) => ({
    value: entityWeightValues[index % entityWeightValues.length].value,
    measure: '%' as const,
    trend: 'positive' as const,
  }));

  const buildRow = (
    title: string,
    cells: Array<typeof dash | (typeof ytdTemplate)[number]>,
  ): ComparisonLineData => ({
    title,
    data: [
      dash,
      dash,
      dash,
      ...Array.from(
        { length: entityCount },
        (_, index) => cells[index] ?? dash,
      ),
      dash,
    ],
  });

  return [
    buildRow('Weight ABI', entityCells),
    buildRow('K/hl', entityCells),
    buildRow('MACO Margin', entityCells),
    buildRow('MACO Margin vs Country', entityCells),
    buildRow('MACO/hl', entityCells),
    buildRow('MACO/hl vs Country', entityCells),
    buildRow('YTD vs LY', ytdTemplate),
    buildRow('YTD vs Budget', ytdTemplate),
    buildRow('Growth Contrib.', growthTemplate),
  ];
}
